latestVersion.changelog:
Vidix AI Photo Video Generator 1.0.0

- Initial release: Quickly turn 5–10 product photos (JPG and other image formats) into animated, shareable 1080p videos with transitions and music.
- No video editing required: Just upload files and describe the desired output—no need to set timelines or export options.
- Fast processing: Most jobs complete in 30–60 seconds with instant download links.
- Credit-based usage with simple, auto-handled authentication (100 free credits on sign-up, tokens valid for 7 days).
- Robust error handling and workflow guidance, including previews, edit state summaries, and file support details.
